data.value: Open the terminal UI (the default command)

data.name: AppCommands_Config
data.value: Read and write settings in the config file, like git config: get <key>: print a value, exit code 1 when unset; unset <key>: remove it set <key> <value>: true/false and integers are stored as such, the rest as text list [--all]: print key=value lines, secrets masked; path: print the config file's path

data.name: AppCommands_Plugins
data.value: List the plugins, whether they are enabled, and their settings

data.name: AppCommands_Help
data.value: Show help for azsb or one of its commands

data.name: AppCommands_SubscriptionOption
data.value: Azure subscription to start in, by name or ID; emulator for the local emulator

data.name: AppCommands_NamespaceOption
data.value: Namespace of that subscription to open, by name or host name; needs --subscription

data.name: AppCommands_OpenOption
data.value: Queue, topic or topic/subscription of that namespace to open, by exact name; /dlq or /active picks the tab. Or a list: queues, topics or subscriptions. Needs --namespace

data.name: AppCommands_ThemeOption
data.value: Colors for a dark or light terminal background: auto (default; COLORFGBG, else dark), dark or light; overrides ui.theme
